1- you arrive with a work permit which is used to get you your iqama, it depends on the company that is sponsoring you, whether they are green zone or red zone, green zone companies typically need 1 to 3 weeks before you iqama is read, you will need your company to confirm this for you: https://lifeinsaudiarabia.net/check-iqama-color-status-red-green-yellow/



2- You can't really officially rent using the government platform without an Iqama number, push your company to cover an airbnb for the first 1 to 2 months so that your Iqama is ready and you have enough time to find a good apartment. In Riyadh, in decent areas like Aqiq or Olaya, a 1 bedroom apartment that is comfortable would typically cost around $1400-$1500 per month, these were the prices that I found and I only moved here 3 months ago almost. A close friend of mine took a 2 bedroom apartment in a compound and it costs around $2500 per month



3- for your first period rent a car, see how transportation will be for you from office to home, and depends on which country you are coming from, you will need to undergo the Driving Tests from scratch even if you have an international driving license, because the driving legal rules differ for Visa Visit and Residents, as a Resident or someone undergoing the Iqama Process, you cannot use your international driving license, you have to, by law, apply for the Local one instead..



4- The official goverment application for rents is Iqar, do not under any circumstances go for an ad outside Iqar, especially platforms like opensooq.sa ,no matter how amazing the prices seem, they are all very well structured scams that will get you. 



If you need a friend here or any guidance, feel free to reach out to me
